title: ChatMessage
description:
A single chat message.

Serialization follows the OpenAI chat-completions schema: `content` may be null on assistant tool-call messages; `tool_calls` and `tool_call_id` are omitted when absent.

content.description: Text content. `None` is legal for assistant messages that only carry tool calls.

tool_call_id.description: Required on `role: tool` messages: the tool call this answers.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls requested by the assistant.

ToolCall.description:
A tool call requested by the model.

Wire format is the OpenAI function-calling shape: `{"id": "...", "type": "function", "function": {"name": "...", "arguments": "<json string>"}}`. The `arguments` field is exposed as a parsed [`Value`]; serialization re-encodes it to the string form the API expects.

id.description: Provider-assigned call id (echoed back in the tool-result message).
